# Temple Scroll Column 10 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Temple Scroll Column 10 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 10:4 — "chuqqat 'olam" — everlasting statute (recurring)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-statute of-eternity for-your-generations" | Construct chain with hyphenation |
| LOGOS | "an everlasting statute throughout your generations" | Standard formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "a permanent law for all your generations" | Dynamic rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. Consistent with all prior columns. "Everlasting statute" is the project standard for chuqqat 'olam.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:7 — "who settled them in the land" — divine action

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "who-placed them in-the-land" | Literal rendering of sim/natan |
| LOGOS | "who settled them in the land" | Standard formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "who gave them the land as their home" | Expanded dynamic rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "who settled them in the land." This is accurate and concise. EMET's "placed" is too mechanical for a relational divine act; PNEUMA's expansion adds "home" without textual basis.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:10 — "zikkaron teru'ah" — memorial of trumpet blast

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-memorial of-trumpet-blast" | Literal construct with hyphenation |
| LOGOS | "a memorial of trumpet blast" | Standard formal rendering (cf. Lev 23:24) |
| PNEUMA | "a day of remembrance marked by trumpet blasts" | Expanded dynamic rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "a memorial of trumpet blast." This matches the standard English of Leviticus 23:24. PNEUMA's expansion adds "day" and "marked by" that are not in the Hebrew construct phrase.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:10 — "miqra' qodesh" — holy convocation (recurring)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-holy convocation" | Literal with hyphenation |
| LOGOS | "a holy convocation" | Standard formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "a sacred assembly" | Dynamic equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering "a holy convocation." Consistent with Column 3 precedent.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:12 — yearling lambs phrasing (recurring)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "seven he-lambs sons-of-a-year" | Literal construct preserving benei shanah |
| LOGOS | "seven male lambs a year old" | Standard formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "seven one-year-old male lambs" | Natural English word order |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. Consistent with Column 4 precedent.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements: 5*
*Resolution: LOGOS 5, EMET 0, PNEUMA 0, Compromise 0*
